next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative RESERVE clause the sequential one. 2023 writes one RESERVE clause (12.4.5.14) into both the relative format (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR9 'Format 2 shall be specified only for a relative file') and the sequential format (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR11), so the sameness holds. The clause's content (§2023:12.4.5.14.3 GR1) is the sequential RESERVE rule's record, not a part of this one.
